text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — High 5xx and 429 spike observed in production. Affected: model-family 'redwood-3-small'. Error rate 5xx=6.8% over 5m, 429s up 12% — paging oncall @sanjay.
Maria Chen: seeing alerts too, a bunch of customers getting 429s on /v1/generate with redwood-3-small. Can oncall take?
Sanjay Patel: taking. jumping in — starting quick triage. any recent deploys?
Priya K: no deploys from platform in the last hour. ETA of spike start ~1755009500 per metrics. Looks like TPM throttle hit for redwood-3-small on hosted pool A.
Lee R: confirmed in dashboard: per-model TPM currently set to 600 for redwood-3-small on pool A, sustained concurrent request surge pushing through. Queue length increased -> backend 502/504s.
Sanjay Patel: plan: raise TPM for redwood-3-small in pool A to relieve client throttles, enable temporary per-route backoff header for non-critical routes, and add short-term token bucket shaping. Will also enable fallback to redwood-3-medium if latency degrades.
Maria Chen: +1. please post commands and change id. Need to notify support and customers impacted.
Sanjay Patel: executing increase now. Command: ```curl -X POST "https://console.internal.redwood/api/v1/quotas/model" -H "Authorization: Bearer xxxxx" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model_family":"redwood-3-small","pool":"pool-A","tpm":1200,"rpm":60000,"reason":"mitigation-1755009876"}'```
ops-bot: change_request accepted — request id cr-20260315-842. Applying to pool-A nodes (n=18).
Sanjay Patel: applied. rolling update to quota configs, should propagate in ~30s. watching metrics.
Priya K: I can patch routing rule to divert 15% of new traffic to redwood-3-medium as safety net. Want me to proceed?
Sanjay Patel: yes please. Use canary routing rule: ```route add --from api-gateway --to redwood-3-medium --weight 0.15 --match "model_family:redwood-3-small" --reason "mitigation-1755009876"```
Priya K: done. ops-bot: routing change id rt-551 applied.
Maria Chen: customer-impact note: CS flagged three customers (acme-corp, beta-saas, dataforge) complaining about 429s and degraded latency. Please send short incident note once stable.
Lee R: metrics: 429 rate fell from 12% -> 1.1% within 90s after TPM bump + routing. 5xxs trending down. CPU on pool-A nodes rose ~8%, memory steady. No new errors in logs aside from transient queue drops.
Sanjay Patel: good. Keeping extra headroom but marking mitigation as temporary. Will revert TPM after traffic normalizes or switch to scheduled config.
Maria Chen: oncall handoff — I'm going off in 10m, @Lee R will be primary for next hour. Sanjay can stay monitoring.
Lee R: acknowledged taking handoff. I'll keep dashboards open and will escalate if 5xx > 2% for 5m.
Sanjay Patel: adding runbook note: "mitigation-1755009876" -> bumped TPM to 1200 for redwood-3-small on pool-A, added 15% canary to redwood-3-medium, routing id rt-551, change id cr-20260315-842.
Priya K: reminder to add unit tests for quota propagation in next sprint — we had a blind spot where per-model quota can't be hot-rolled for certain cached routing configs.
Maria Chen: agree — will create ticket. Also CS note to be drafted: short summary + customers impacted + current mitigation + ETA for rollback.
ops-bot: monitor alert: mitigation-1755009876 resolved threshold — 5xx < 1% and 429 < 2% sustained 6m.
Sanjay Patel: marking incident mitigated. leaving a follow-up to confirm rollback plan in 2 hours if stable.
Lee R: after-action items: (1) add telemetry for per-model token bucket headroom, (2) automation to raise TPM for sudden request bursts with guardrails, (3) postmortem if recurrence.
Maria Chen: thanks everyone. I'll ping CS and close the loop. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident note appended to incident-1755009876: "TPM bump + canary routing applied, customers impacted notified, monitoring green."
